projects.title: Bangla Hate Speech Detection (CSE 3200 Project)
description: Built a **BiLSTM model** using a 5K self-collected dataset for detecting Bangla hate comments.
Applied **TF-IDF**, preprocessing, and evaluated the model with precision and recall.

projects.title: Luminous Learners Portal (CSE 3100 Project)
description: Developed a study portal website for managing lectures, notes, assignments, and e-resources.
Built with **Django**, HTML, CSS, and Bootstrap.

projects.title: Hotel Management System (CSE 2100 Project)
description: Created a **Java-based GUI** hotel system with billing, reservations, file handling, and OOP-based modular design.
